GraceChangeDesignContext.Rationale: This package isolates audit finding F11 and filesystem escape paths from network and credential policy. File selection, artifact bytes, and export are related data-plane operations but remain distinct capabilities.

Alternatives.Alternative: Pass an approved root path to the feature. Rejected because path reuse, aliases, and later filesystem changes can widen authority outside the broker.
Optimize immediately for shared memory. Rejected because bounded copied chunks are simpler evidence until measured throughput requires a different transport.

DeferredDecisions.Decision: The streaming transport and chunk size are selected from memory, throughput, cancellation, and implementation-complexity measurements.

Scenarios.Scenario: A feature can inspect selected download bytes but cannot export them until a separate destination and overwrite decision are authorized.
A file is replaced through a reparse point between selection and write; sink-side identity validation denies the stale portal.
